reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low and I always forget pills at home when I travel, so a tear-and-go sachet in my bag actually fits my life. I'd try one box at the $24.99 launch price, not two.
objection: It's one form of magnesium, when other brands put several forms in one capsule. I'm not sure bisglycinate alone is the best deal, and I haven't seen the lab report yet to know it's real.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the product page turned out to be vague, or the lab wasn't actually named, I'd pass. If it checks out, I'm in.
